C0035.title: Sichuan Deyang Police Crack Down on Ticket Scalping Bots for Scenic Spot Admissions
C0035.summary: In September 2024, the Sichuan public security department reported that Deyang police had investigated a ticket-scalping bot case. Police dismantled three criminal groups using bot programs to hoard tickets for multiple scenic spots nationwide and one group developing scalping bots, arresting 34 suspects. They used ticket-snatching software to buy tickets for attractions like the Sanxingdui Museum, reselling tickets originally priced at 72 yuan for 150 to 200 yuan.
